steps: Strukturierte Aufnahme von Sachverhalt, Datenflüssen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Risiken.
Rechtliche und organisatorische Bewertung mit klarer Herleitung und Priorisierung.
Umsetzbare Empfehlungen, Vorlagen, Entscheidungsvorlagen und Reporting-Strukturen.

en.title: onion Consulting | Data Protection, AI Governance & Data Analytics
en.description: Consulting on data protection and GDPR, debt collection and credit reporting, AI governance, Power BI and data analytics.
en.eyebrow: Data protection · AI governance · Data analytics
en.headline:
Make compliance clear.
Manage risks.
Put data to work.
en.lead: onion Consulting supports organisations with GDPR-compliant processes, AI management systems, credit reporting and debt collection matters, and professional Power BI solutions.
en.servicesTitle: Consulting where law, organisation and data meet.
services: Review and documentation of processing activities, legitimate interest assessments, data subject requests, data protection impact assessments, and well-founded statements for supervisory authorities.
Assessment of debt data, adverse credit entries, erasure and rectification requests, SCHUFA and credit reporting processes, and data flows associated with individual engagements.
Development of practical AI policies, role models, risk classifications and management systems aligned with the EU AI Act and ISO/IEC 42001.
Development of efficient data models, Power Query transformations, DAX measures and management reports with clear governance.
en.approachTitle: Pragmatic, documented and ready for audit.
steps: Structured assessment of the facts, data flows, responsibilities and risks.
Legal and organisational assessment with clear reasoning and priorities.
Actionable recommendations, templates, decision papers and reporting structures.
en.contactTitle: Looking to establish professional data protection, AI governance or reporting?
en.contactText: Send a brief message outlining your topic, objectives and preferred timeframe.
